title: 第22章 付出代价第23章 候选人
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
沉翔打开熔炉，取出一颗非常精美的元灵丹。它浑身包裹着金色光华，雕刻精美，中心有白色火焰般的光芒在跳动。
苏媚瑶出来了。她穿着休闲的白色连衣裙，头发乱糟糟的。但这依然掩盖不了她的绝世美貌，反而增添了一种奇异的魅力。她轻咬着唇，娇俏的脸上写满了不悦。看到沉翔脸上那一抹猥琐的笑容，她忍不住轻轻哼了一声。
“媚瑶姐，我是老手了，你不用担心，我不会咬你舌头，而是怕你咬我舌头！”
沉翔笑着说道，走向了苏媚瑶。
苏媚瑶看了一眼元灵丹。沉翔确实炼制成功了，而且品质上乘，这让她暗自放弃了一切反抗。
“你……你想怎么开始？”
苏媚瑶俏脸微红，低声问道。
“抬起头，闭上眼睛，剩下的就交给我了！”
沉翔舔了舔嘴唇，邪恶的笑道。
苏媚瑶娇羞地吐了一口，然后闭上眼睛，抬起头来面对沉翔。她的心跳加速，心情变得无比紧张，尤其是当她感觉到沉翔正在渐渐靠近的时候。
沉翔看着那个绝色风骚的美女。他情不自禁地用手背轻轻抚摸着苏媚瑶的脸颊，品味着那雪白滑腻的感觉。苏媚瑶的睫毛微微颤抖了一下，娇哼道：“快点，别惹我！”
沉翔调皮地笑道。如果答应打赌，苏媚瑶也愿意接受损失。随后，两道身影拥抱在一起！
两人都沉醉在这种美妙的感觉中，完全忘记了时间。不知过了多久，这温馨的场景被打破，龙雪怡娇喝道：“有人来了！”
这个时候，沉翔就舍不得苏媚瑶了。当她离开沉翔的怀抱时，她看着他，眼神里带着迷茫而美丽的表情。不过，她很快就低下头吐了口唾沫，然后又回到了擂台上。
沉翔咧嘴一笑，舔了舔嘴唇，细细品味着那种缠绵的感觉。
苏媚瑶回到擂台内的那个小住处后，就瘫倒在床上。她没有说话，低着头思考着什么。她的脸色还略带红润。看到这一幕，白幽幽愣住了。
“沉翔，什么是接吻？好吃吗？我也想尝尝！”
龙雪怡忽然问道，声音中充满了好奇。
“吃我的屁股，整天只想着吃吗？小家伙走开，这是大人的事！”
沉翔嗤笑道。

“哼，我在龙蛋里已经几千年了，你这个小家伙！”
龙雪怡柔声呵斥道。
沉翔离开了包间。当他来到自己的小花园时，就看到丹长老呆呆的站在九阳炎树下。
看到沉翔到来，丹长老猛地回头，急忙问道：“这里到底发生了什么？”
沉翔挠了挠头，笑道：“这也不算太糟糕吧？”
丹长老冷哼道：“废话，五彩莲、九素炎树、火灵草、养魂草、神灵花、金灵树、千脉树……哪一个不是好东西？老实告诉我，你到底从哪里得到这些东西的！”
九阳炎树已经结出了两颗果实，丹长老很清楚，它们并不是沉翔最近种下的。
丹长老刚刚闭关出来，对于外界的事情，她根本就没有任何头绪。不然的话，也没必要问沉翔到底是怎么回事。
“你一定要保守秘密！这件事不能告诉别人！”
content_en:
Chen Xiang opened the furnace and took out a very exquisite Yuanling Pill. It is covered with golden brilliance, beautifully carved, and has a white flame-like light beating in the center.
Su Meiyao came out. She was wearing a casual white dress and her hair was messy. But this still cannot conceal her peerless beauty, but instead adds a strange charm. She bit her lip lightly, displeasure written on her pretty face. Seeing the lewd smile on Chen Xiang's face, she couldn't help but snorted softly.
"Sister Meiyao, I'm a veteran, don't worry, I won't bite your tongue, but I'm afraid you will bite mine!"
Chen Xiang said with a smile and walked towards Su Meiyao.
Su Meiyao glanced at the Yuanling Pill. Chen Xiang had indeed succeeded in refining it, and the quality was high, which made her secretly give up all resistance.
"How...how do you want to start?"
Su Meiyao's pretty face turned red and she asked in a low voice.
"Lift your head, close your eyes, and leave the rest to me!"
Chen Xiang licked his lips and smiled evilly.
Su Meiyao spit out shyly, then closed her eyes and raised her head to face Chen Xiang. Her heartbeat accelerated and she became extremely nervous, especially when she felt that Chen Xiang was getting closer.
Chen Xiang looked at the stunning and coquettish beauty. He couldn't help but gently caressed Su Meiyao's cheek with the back of his hand, savoring the white and creamy feeling. Su Meiyao's eyelashes trembled slightly and she hummed, "Hurry up, don't mess with me!"
Chen Xiang smiled mischievously. If she agrees to the bet, Su Meiyao is willing to accept the loss. Then, the two figures hugged each other!
Both of them were immersed in this wonderful feeling and completely forgot about time. After an unknown amount of time, this warm scene was broken. Long Xueyi shouted: "Someone is coming!"
At this time, Chen Xiang couldn't bear to leave Su Meiyao. When she left Chen Xiang's arms, she looked at him with a confused and beautiful expression in her eyes. However, she quickly lowered her head, spat, and returned to the ring.
Chen Xiang grinned and licked his lips, savoring the lingering feeling.
After Su Meiyao returned to the small residence inside the ring, she collapsed on the bed. She said nothing, lowering her head and thinking about something. Her face was still slightly rosy. Seeing this scene, Bai Youyou was stunned.
"Chen Xiang, what is kissing? Is it delicious? I want to try it too!"
Long Xueyi asked suddenly, her voice full of curiosity.
"Eat my ass and just think about eating all day? Go away little guy, this is an adult's business!"
Chen Xiang sneered.
"Hmph, I've been in the dragon egg for thousands of years, you little guy!"
Long Xueyi scolded softly.
Chen Xiang left the private room. When he came to his small garden, he saw Elder Dan standing blankly under the Nine Sun Flame Tree.
Seeing Chen Xiang's arrival, Elder Dan turned around suddenly and asked hurriedly: "What exactly happened here?"
Chen Xiang scratched his head and said with a smile: "This isn't too bad, is it?"
Elder Dan snorted coldly: "Nonsense, five-color lotus, nine-element flame tree, fire spirit grass, soul-nourishing grass, spirit flower, golden spirit tree, thousand-vein tree... which one is not a good thing? Tell me honestly, where did you get these things from!"
The Nine Sun Flame Tree has already produced two fruits, and Elder Dan knows very well that they were not planted recently by Chen Xiang.
Elder Dan had just come out of seclusion, and she had no clue about what was going on in the outside world. Otherwise, there is no need to ask Chen Xiang what is going on.
"You must keep it a secret! Don't tell others about this!"
